title: customer-compliance-onramp-intake-ui-estimator-suggester
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a customer-facing intake experience in Redwood Console that captures security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires) and returns an immediate, transparent prioritization signal plus a recommended contract excerpt and runbook. The intake should reduce back-and-forth by surfacing: estimated SLA/response window, evidence checklist, suggested contractual language (DPA clauses, data residency text), and an automated internal routing plan to the correct team (security, legal, infra). This ticket covers the MVP UX + backend classifier + contract-snippet microservice; subsequent tickets will expand to LLM-powered questionnaire parsing and evidence autopopulation.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new 'Compliance request' flow appears under Support > Requests with a 6-step form that captures: customer details, compliance category (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaire), data residency, urgency, attachments, and optional questionnaire file.
SLA estimator: the UI displays a computed response window (e.g., 1 business day / 3 business days / 10 business days) and rationale based on customer tier, region, and request type.
Contract snippet suggester: for DPA and data residency asks the flow returns at least one suggested clause (plain text) and a link to the corresponding legal playbook page.
Router: submission creates an internal ticket in Linear tagged with predicted priority and assigned queue (security/legal/infra/customer-success) using matching rules from the classifier.
Evidence checklist: generated checklist (SOC2 artifact types, logs, configurations) is attached to the created internal ticket.
Audit trail: every submission stores timestamps, submitter identity, and attachments in the evidence bucket with immutable metadata.
UX validation: product + security review sign off on wording and presentation for suggested contractual language.
Metrics: the flow emits events for 'submitted', 'accepted-by-team', 'first-response' and is visible in Console telemetry dashboards.
Security review required flag present and set to true in ticket metadata.
out_of_scope: Full LLM-driven questionnaire auto-fill and final contract negotiation (future phase).
Automated legal sign-off or contract execution (legal must approve suggested snippets).
On-prem/private deployment automation for evidence collection (will require separate integrations).
comments: 2026-02-15 Aisha Raman: Initial draft of scope and acceptance criteria. Goal is to cut average triage time for compliance asks by 40%.
2026-02-18 Marco Lin: Backend APIs sketched; propose a lightweight "snippet" microservice (read-only legal snippets) to avoid coupling with Legal's Confluence.
2026-02-22 Sana Kapoor: Security approves evidence checklist taxonomy but requests immutable evidence storage and access logs; flagged as must-have.
2026-02-24 Daniel Ortiz: Legal provided three canonical DPA clause variants; requested UI copy be prefaced with 'Suggested language — legal review required.'
2026-02-27 Design review: user testing with 6 pilot customers showed the SLA estimator increased perceived transparency; small copyUX tweaks noted (link to figma).
2026-03-01 Marco Lin: Engineering spike complete; backend prototype returns SLA estimate based on customer_tier + region + request_type. Next: wire routing to Linear via API.
notes: This ticket is intended to be a low-friction onramp for enterprise customers with regulatory needs. KPI: reduce average first-response time for high-impact compliance requests from 7 days to 2 days and reduce legal back-and-forth by surfacing vetted clause snippets at intake. Follow-on work: auto-evidence collection, LLM parsing for questionnaires, and SLA-driven automation of canary responses.
